activity.role: Calligrapher and writer of the Lantingji Xu preface
activity.notes: Wang Xizhi composed the preface associated with the Lanting gathering of 353 during the Eastern Jin period. This is a dated personal literary/calligraphic activity point, not his whole career. The surviving Lantingji Xu exemplars are later transmissions/copies; this request makes no claim that Wang's autograph survives. Eastern Jin (317–420 CE) is a distinct historical polity; Western Jin, earlier Jin state, and Jurchen Jin are not the same polity. active_in records historical location/context, not government service.

sources.title: Tokyo National Museum — Wang Xizhi and the Lantingji Xu
sources.citation_text: The museum exhibition identifies Wang Xizhi with Lantingji Xu of the Eastern Jin period, dated 353 CE, and distinguishes later copied exemplars of the work.
